pages.text: Like every moth, it roosts on trunks and leaves, and bites back if angered. Wear gold and it will not bite.

$(item)Mesmerize$()$(br)Within 24 blocks, looking near a gold moth slowly turns your view toward it. Look straight at it to break free, and gold gives no protection.$(br2)One moth holds you at a time. A gold moth specimen mounted in a frame does the same.
